name: Vent Row: Combat 101
read_aloud: The vents start skittering the second the shutter is up. Red brackets pop up over every grate. This is Combat 101.
narrator_line: The vents start skittering the second the shutter is up.
layout: A service hallway lined with floor vents, every grate bent outward, with red UI brackets over the openings.

exits.name: Back through the shutter to the Atrium (Z1).
On to the Vending Gore Arcade (Z3).

features.name: Bent grates and wall pipes (half cover).
Two vents 20 ft apart spill the rats in two groups (00-overview.md section 5.2).
Backing away from a rat triggers the first Opportunity Attack popup.

enemies.note: spoken_name is the live Day-page name. stat_card is the SRD body in this pack. Dean Thudd is not renamed.

quick_run.setup: A vent-lined hall and two waves of giant rats: the floor's first fight.
quick_run.decision: Hold the line together, or chase rats down the hall?
quick_run.on_success: The rats fall and the Crawlers learn initiative, flanking and Opportunity Attacks.
quick_run.on_failure: A Crawler drops and the party spends its first short-rest slot early.
quick_run.cut_short: Run one wave only and resolve the second with a single group check.

loot.text: Dropped change in the vents; the rats carry nothing (00-overview.md section 5.2).

gm_notes: Strong-model notes stay on the Day page. This stub does not copy if_they_do_something_dumb.
